## Authority and scope

Task issue / active claim:

## Changes

State clearly whether these are proposals, source implementation or tested behavior.

## Evidence

Exact commands, environment, outcomes and known limits. Do not claim Windows/UAC/live-runner PASS from mock checks. Do not dispatch hosted Actions during the no-CI gate.

## Boundaries

- No credentials/private output.
- No untrusted public jobs or policy bypass.
- No merge/release or machine changes outside the task.
- CURRENT/handoff checked; any status change is explicit.
